measures.title: Reimposition of the Henry County Special District Mass Transportation Sales Tax (TSPLOST) Referendum
measures.summary: Asks whether to reimpose a special 1% sales and use tax in the special district of Henry County for up to six years to raise up to an estimated $330,000,000 for transportation purposes and projects of Henry County and the cities of Hampton, Locust Grove, McDonough and Stockbridge, as provided in an intergovernmental agreement. Approval would also authorize Henry County to issue up to $80,000,000 in general obligation debt for the Henry County projects.
measures.yesMeans: The 1% transportation sales tax is reimposed for up to six years and the county may issue up to $80 million in general obligation debt for its projects.
measures.noMeans: The transportation sales tax is not reimposed and the debt is not authorized.

measures.id: Henry County Floating Local Option Sales Tax (FLOST) Referendum
measures.title: Floating Local Option Sales Tax (FLOST) to lower property taxes
measures.summary: Asks whether to impose a special 1% sales and use tax for five years within the special district of Henry County, with the proceeds used only to lower property taxes imposed by Henry County and the cities of Hampton, Locust Grove, McDonough and Stockbridge.
measures.yesMeans: A 1% sales tax is imposed for five years and its proceeds are used to lower county and city property taxes.
